title: fsp.linked payload
description: Payload of the fsp.linked event (fsp-service; docs/fsp_integration.md §1, docs/data_model.md §5.1). Emitted on any link-state change, including unlink (link_status=unlinked) and registry failure (link_status=error). history_status stays independent of link failures: no_history is a successful empty result, never an error.

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the candidate (candidate.profiles.id, logical reference).

fsp_id.description: External FSP participant id; null only for a degenerate unlink of an absent link.

history_status.description: Achievement-history state, independent of link failures (docs/fsp_integration.md §6).
